title: Informer: Informer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, Electricity at horizon 336
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using Informer, a sparse-attention transformer with ProbSparse self-attention. On ETTh1, ETTh2, Electricity, at horizon 336, Informer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, Electricity at horizon 336. Reported MSE reduction of 11% versus the strongest prior transformer on ETTh1 at horizon 336. We discuss two limitations: Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference. Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured. Future work should address studying performance under explicit train/test distribution shift. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
